title.narrative: BUSINESS ENVIRONMENT

description.narrative: Lesotho Health and Horticulture Compact - Business Environment and Technical Assistance (BETA) Project; The objective of the Business Environment and Technical Assistance Project (the "BETA Project") to stimulate an increase in firm-level profits and formal employment from a pipeline of Firms supported by the Project, including MSMEs owned by women and youth and Firms in rural areas. The Parties expect inclusive, sustainable private sector growth in Lesotho will be stimulated by creating a robust pipeline of businesses and facilitating a public-private dialogue in which these private sector actors can engage with the Government and the Government can respond.

condition.narrative: Further details on conditions precedent affecting this activity can be found in the top-level parent activities.
